selection_basis: First variant, provisional until listening review; no subjective listening claim.

jobs.prompt: A single compact futuristic assault carbine shot. Instant sharp electric crack, tight mechanical bolt clack and a short dry bass punch. One isolated shot at the very start then silence, under half a second. No automatic burst, no speech, music, ambience or long reverb.

One single futuristic submachine gun shot, at the very start. Tiny sharp high-pitched electrical snap, fast light bolt click, tight dry punch, rapid attack and short clean tail. Compact agile weapon, not a big explosion. No burst, no voice, music, ambience or echo. Half a second.

One single heavy futuristic shotgun blast at the very start. Thick percussive low punch with a broad crunchy electric discharge and a solid mechanical action clack. Short powerful dry tail. No repeated fire, shells falling, voices, music, ambience, echo or long explosion. Half a second.

One single precise futuristic needle pistol shot at the very start. Sharp focused metallic tick with a small high electric ping and compact punch, clean and confident, quick decay. No burst, heavy cannon, voices, music, ambience or echo. Half a second.

One single shot from a heavy futuristic machine gun at the very start. Dense low mechanical thud, hard cycling bolt clank and gritty short electrical crack. Weighty industrial mechanism with a tight dry decay. No burst or multiple shots, no voice, music, ambience or echo. Half a second.

One single precision science fiction marksman rifle shot at the very start. Dry sharp rail snap, bright narrow metallic crack with a restrained resonant coil ring that dies quickly. Precise and controlled. No charging lead-in, burst, voices, music, ambience or reverb. Half a second.

One single powerful futuristic sniper rifle shot at the very start. Razor sharp high voltage crack with a deep concentrated low punch, followed by a descending magnetic coil whine and short dry tail. No charging lead-in, repeated shots, voice, music, ambience or echo. Half a second.

One isolated science fiction plasma orb launch and immediate energy rupture at the very start. Round hollow electric whomp, sizzling fizz and a brief low energy bloom. Organic electronic character, clearly unlike a metal gunshot. No charging lead-in, voice, music, ambience or long reverb. Half a second.

One short precise futuristic projectile hit on armored metal at the very start. Tight tactile metallic tick and small gritty spark snap, dry clean rapid decay. Quiet confirmation accent, not a gunshot or explosion. No ricochet whistle, voice, music, ambience or echo. Half a second.

One compact futuristic energy shield breaking at the very start. Bright crystalline electric snap, briefly shattering energy fragments with a descending electronic fizz. Distinct satisfying confirmation, not glass debris or a huge explosion. No voice, music, ambience or echo. Half a second.

A single compact futuristic rifle reload sequence. Close dry mechanical magazine release click, short magazine movement, firm insertion clack, then a decisive charging bolt snap to finish. Clear beginning and end over two seconds. No gunshots, voice, music, ambience or echo.
